Overview

Matsuyama is a city in with a population of 515,000. The largest city on Shikoku, with one of Japan’s oldest hot spring resorts and a magnificent original castle. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
